2609.28603.title: Learning to Discover Interesting Mathematics
2609.28603.paper_summary: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly able to solve advanced mathematical problems, including many that have been open for decades. This opens the door to expansion of mathematical knowledge at unprecedented scale. Yet, while LLMs may be able to conjecture and prove more and more theorems, it remains open whether this new mathematical knowledge is interesting or useful. We define intrinsic interestingness of a theorem as the ratio between the length of its proof and the length of its statement. We show that this correlates strongly with an extrinsic measure of the downstream utility of a theorem. We identify the difficulty of a proof conditioned on a set of premises as a useful primitive for computing these metrics, and train a 27B model that predicts proof difficulty more accurately than frontier general-purpose models. Optimizing for our metric creates a model capable of producing more interesting theorems, while also reducing substantial or full overlap with Mathlib from 91.9% to 30.6%, showcasing the creation of more out-of-distribution math. We show that our system can generate candidate theorems, select the most interesting among them, and iteratively build on a self-expanding mathematical library. These metrics provide a practical and quantifiable signal for ranking conjectures and guiding proof search within formal mathematical libraries. Our framework provides a path towards self-expanding, machine-verified mathematical libraries that can choose worthwhile statements without relying on human-supplied targets.
2609.28603.paper_summary_zh: 最近，大型語言模型（LLMs）在解決高級數學問題方面的能力日益增強，包括許多已經懸而未決數十年的問題。這為數學知識的擴展打開了前所未有的門。 然而，儘管LLMs可能能夠推測和證明越來越多的定理，但這種新的數學知識是否有趣或有用仍然是個未知數。我們將定理的內在有趣性定義為其證明的長度與其陳述的長度之比。我們展示了這與定理的外在效用的下游測量有著強烈的相關性。我們將基於一組前提的證明難度確定為計算這些指標的有用原始概念，並訓練了一個27B的模型，該模型比前沿通用模型更準確地預測證明的難度。針對我們的指標進行優化創建了一個能夠產生更有趣定理的模型，同時將與Mathlib的實質性或完全重疊從91.9%降低到30.6%，展示了創造更多分布外數學的能力。我們展示了我們的系統可以生成候選定理，從中選擇最有趣的，並迭代地構建一個自我擴展的數學庫。這些指標提供了一個實用且可量化的信號，用於對猜想進行排名並指導在正式數學庫中的證明搜索。我們的框架提供了一條通往自我擴展、機器驗證的數學庫的道路，能夠在不依賴人類提供的目標的情況下選擇有價值的陳述。
